artifacts.note: Byte-identical to the 20260818 artefact. It predates the thresholds and feature_version keys, so cowmata.inference scores it at feature_version=1 with 0.5 thresholds, exactly as before. Retrain to gain per-event thresholds and the version-2 feature bank.

Kept for provenance only. The 20260819 model is MultiTaskMSTCN with a different architecture and a different label set (TAIL_WAGGING removed, MOUNTING/MOUNTED_BY added), so this checkpoint cannot be resumed or loaded. It was never a deployable model.
